ctx: TITLE 7. RECEIPTS, DOCUMENTS OF TITLE, AND OTHER INSTRUMENTS

l: The holder of a protested draft is entitled to damages in an amount equal to 10 percent of the amount of the draft, plus interest and the costs of suit, if:
(1) the draft was drawn by a merchant in this state on the merchant's agent or factor outside this state; and
(2) the drawer's or indorser's liability on the draft has been fixed.
